units.function: Embedded-PostgreSQL tests for Issue review-verdict actor policies: default anyone, reviewer other than the transition requester, and human-only; also identifies the confirmation interaction representing the verdict.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> issue-review-policy service -> Issue plus activity-log history in Drizzle/PostgreSQL; authorization/membership is expected from the caller.
units.keyDataModels: Issue reviewPolicy and company; typed actor principal; activity transition into in_review with requester and reviewInteractionId; confirmation creator; structured HttpError code/policy/allowedActor.
units.lifecycle: Record transition into in_review -> recover requester and optional verdict interaction from activity -> authorize a verdict actor under current Issue policy -> reject with stable structured error or allow continuation.
units.testAssessment: All 5 tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable. Intended coverage validates the no-query default, requester exclusion, transition-vs-snapshot distinction, interaction classification and human principal typing. Missing are policy snapshot/version changes, absent/duplicated/tampered history, tenant and write-grant enforcement, human role/certification, quorum, exact decision binding and race conditions.
units.designRationale: Prevent the Agent that requested review from approving its own work when configured, permit a human-only gate, and keep verdict authorization separate from generic confirmation handling.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must enforce responsibility contracts and risk-based approval policies with verifiable human authority, conflict rules, separation of duties and an immutable binding to the exact action and evidence being decided.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT explicit typed verdict policies, transition-aware requester identity and stable structured denial codes. Replace default-open with policy-derived safe defaults; snapshot policy/version and requester in an authoritative ReviewObligation; require tenant membership, write grant, role/certification and conflict checks; bind each signed decision to action/work/contract/Agent/human/evidence/result digests and support quorum/escalation.
units.responsibilityConflict: An arbitrary authenticated user is accepted by this function for human_only and any actor is accepted by default without a database check. The decision is not bound to exact reviewed content or a policy snapshot, so changed work or policy can inherit an authorization intended for another state.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL for Company OS: verdict authorization lacks exact action/artifact/evidence digest and immutable policy-version binding. HIGH default-open risk: null policy performs no data lookup. HIGH human-authority gap: principal type alone is sufficient here; role, membership, certification, conflict and grant are external assumptions. HIGH verification gap: all database tests skipped. MEDIUM audit dependence: requester identity is reconstructed from mutable/retained activity history without tested ambiguity or tamper handling. POSITIVE: stable denial codes, actor typing and transition-aware requester selection are sound primitives.
